“Stand for a little while next to your holocaust,

And after he had quickly departed,
et imposui vitulum et arietem desuper.
and I have placed a calf and a ram on each.”
Dominus autem posuit verbum in ore ejus,
Then the Lord placed the word in his mouth,
Reversus invenit stantem Balac juxta holocaustum suum,
Returning, he found Balak standing next to his holocaust,
with all the leaders of the Moabites.
And taking up his parable, he said:
De Aram adduxit me Balac rex Moabitarum,
king of the Moabites, has led me from Aram,
from the mountains of the east.
For what reason would I condemn him,
whom the Lord does not condemn?
I will look upon him from the tops of the stones,
and I will consider him from the hills.
and they shall not be counted among the nations.
Who can number the dust that is Jacob,
and who can know the number of the stock of Israel?
May my soul die a just death,
et fiant novissima mea horum similia.
and may my end be like theirs.”
“What is this that you are doing?
ut malediceres inimicis meis vocavi te,
I called for you, in order to curse my enemies,
et tu e contrario benedicis eis.
and to the contrary, you bless them.”
Num aliud possum loqui, nisi quod jusserit Dominus?
“How can I say anything other than what the Lord orders?”
Veni mecum in alterum locum unde partem Israël videas,
“Come with me to another place, from where you may see a portion of Israel,
though you cannot see them all.
Cumque duxisset eum in locum sublimem,
And when he had led him to a lofty place,
on the top of mount Pisgah,
et impositis supra vitulo atque ariete,
and placing upon each a calf and a ram,
while I continue on to meet him.”
And when the Lord had met him,
and had put the word in his mouth,
and you shall say this to him.”
Reversus invenit eum stantem juxta holocaustum suum,
Returning, he found him standing next to his holocaust,
and the leaders of the Moabites were with him.
God is not like a man, so that he would lie,
ut mentiatur, nec ut filius hominis,
nor is he like a son of man, so that he would be changed.
I was led here to bless,
and I have no strength to hinder the blessing.
There is no idol in Jacob;
neither is there a false image to be seen in Israel.
Dominus Deus ejus cum eo est,
The Lord his God is with him,
et clangor victoriæ regis in illo.
and the resound of royal victory is in him.
God has led him away from Egypt;
his strength is like that of the rhinoceros.
There is no soothsaying in Jacob,
et Israëli quid operatus sit Deus.
it shall be told to Jacob and to Israel what God has wrought.
the people will rise up like a lioness,

Nonne dixi tibi quod quidquid mihi Deus imperaret,

si forte placeat Deo ut inde maledicas eis.

And when he had led him on to the top of mount Peor,
